svg.desc: Friday drives the coding CLIs already signed in on the computer. It listens on 127.0.0.1.
svg.text: Agents share a board, each in its own worktree
Friday drives the coding CLIs already signed in on the computer. It listens on 127.0.0.1.

g.text: TALK
Agents message
A rename, a question, an answer.
You see every message in the session.
SPLIT
Own worktree
One agent posts the task board.
Each part runs in its own copy
of the repo.
CHECK
Another agent
A finished task is checked by
another agent, then you read
the diff and note any line.
LOCAL
What leaves the machine
The app asks before it sends anonymous usage counts to PostHog.
It sends nothing before you answer. Prompts, code, paths, and accounts stay off that send.
FRIDAY_NO_TELEMETRY=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 turns the counts off.
An MCP client on the computer can start a Friday session.
